findings.criterion: `docs/plan-review-gate.md` and the generated `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` describe the new grades. Verified: the guide is regenerated from the registry, not hand-edited.
findings.detail: docs/plan-review-gate.md correctly describes all three new grades (contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration) at lines 216–228. However, docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md's G7 section (line 231) still reads the pre-update text: 'This criterion maps its severity onto the existing `divergent_implementation` plan axis — a leaf diverging from its parent IS exactly that signal.' — it does not include the new grade mapping ('That axis is graded by DIVERGENCE KIND (plan-v4), so map onto the grade…') that was added to plan_review_G7.md. The guide was not regenerated after the G7 prompt was updated, so the new grades are absent from the generated guide. Searches for 'contradicts_reality', 'DIVERGENCE KIND', 'omits_required_site', and 'incomplete_enumeration' in docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md all return no matches.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
